Key Business Insights

  • The largest overall loss is across the full journey from page view to purchase, with conversion at 16.5%; the sharpest adjacent-stage drop is payment info to purchase at 91.9%.
  • Email is the strongest traffic source for conversion at 33.9%, materially ahead of paid ads at 21.1%.
  • Organic generates the most revenue at $37,280, supported by the largest visitor base.
  • The overall funnel converts 5,000 visitors into 826 buyers, or 16.5%.
  • The average order value is $106.51, with 826 purchase events and $87,975.11 in revenue.
  • The average customer journey takes 24.6 minutes from first page view to purchase, including 11.1 minutes to add to cart.
  • Social traffic is the weakest source on conversion, suggesting an opportunity to improve audience targeting, landing-page alignment, or offer messaging for that channel.
Note: KPI and chart calculations use distinct users for funnel stages, purchase events for orders, and purchase-event amounts for revenue. Missing purchase amounts are treated as zero in total revenue.
